title: Huron Named a 2026 Best Firm to Work For by Consulting Magazine for 16th Consecutive Year
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Huron Consulting Group Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
*Employee feedback recognizes Huron's culture of belonging, career growth, innovation, and leadership*


CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 22, 2026-- Global professional services firm Huron (NASDAQ: HURN) today announced it has been named one of Consulting Magazine's 2026 Best Firms to Work For, marking the 16th consecutive year the firm has received the recognition. The annual award honors consulting firms based on employee feedback about their workplace experience across areas including culture, career development, client engagement, compensation and benefits, leadership, and work-life balance.


"Being recognized as a Best Firm to Work For 16 years in a row is especially meaningful because this recognition reflects the experiences and voices of our people," said[Mark Hussey](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.huronconsultinggroup.com%2Fen%2Four-experts%2Fmark-hussey&esheet=54608884&newsitemid=20260922453390&lan=en-US&anchor=Mark+Hussey&index=1&md5=0d380b9760d37a5679664c23f0b3eed9) , chief executive officer and president of[Huron](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.huronconsultinggroup.com%2Fen&esheet=54608884&newsitemid=20260922453390&lan=en-US&anchor=Huron&index=2&md5=1049719774ab29df99e017980cdb1ba1) . "Their passion, curiosity, collaboration, and commitment to helping our clients solve complex challenges continue to shape our culture where our teams can grow, innovate, and make a meaningful impact."


Huron continues to invest in its people through leadership development, mentorship, career advancement opportunities and programs designed to foster an inclusive, high-performing workplace where employees can bring their authentic selves to work. These investments help employees grow and thrive while strengthening Huron's ability to deliver exceptional results for clients. The firm's collaborative culture encourages employees to embrace innovation, challenge conventional thinking, and work shoulder-to-shoulder with clients across industries to navigate complex business and operational challenges.


The recognition adds to a growing list of workplace and employer-brand honors earned by Huron in recent years, reflecting the firm's continued focus on delivering a positive employee experience, creating opportunities for employees to build their careers and contributing meaningful results for clients and communities.


Consulting Magazine's Best Firms to Work For recognition evaluates workplace experiences through comprehensive employee survey feedback across key categories, including culture, career development, client engagement, compensation and benefits, firm leadership, and work-life balance.


Huron offers opportunities to work alongside industry-leading experts across industries to shape the future of organizations around the world. Explore careers and opportunities at Huron at[www.huronconsultinggroup.com/careers](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.huronconsultinggroup.com%2Fcareers&esheet=54608884&newsitemid=20260922453390&lan=en-US&anchor=www.huronconsultinggroup.com%2Fcareers&index=3&md5=555e9b750a05995e3f07187e61e7d6fe) .


**ABOUT HURON**


Huron is a global professional services firm that collaborates with organizations to help solve their most complex challenges and achieve their most ambitious goals. Working across the private and public sectors, we partner closely with clients to improve performance, accelerate transformation, and unlock new opportunities for growth.


Our clients choose us because of our deep industry and technical expertise and proven track record of turning sound strategies into action. By combining practical experience, innovative thinking, and advanced analytics and technology, Huron helps organizations translate today’s ideas into tangible results and long-term value. Learn more at[www.huronconsultinggroup.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.huronconsultinggroup.com%2F&esheet=54608884&newsitemid=20260922453390&lan=en-US&anchor=www.huronconsultinggroup.com&index=4&md5=bb6eebbfc8f80f829b66ab597add1354) .
